title: Vote: add the variant type to the REST catalog spec
summary: Neelesh Salian called a 72-hour vote on adding the variant type to the REST catalog OpenAPI spec (PR #17256), so that variant columns can be represented in table schemas exchanged over REST. The thread consists of +1 votes with no objections. Russell Spitzer, voting binding, said this is what the Java, Rust, Go and C++ implementations already ship. Okumin, non-binding, thanked the author for including REST compatibility kit updates as a follow-up task and said the Apache Hive community relies on the kit to develop its Iceberg REST API. On August 2nd Neelesh said the voting has concluded and that a result email would follow; the result itself is not stated in this thread.

positions.stance: +1 binding; the change matches what the Java, Rust, Go and C++ implementations already ship.
+1 non-binding; welcomes the compatibility kit updates as a follow-up, since Apache Hive uses the kit for its Iceberg REST API.

outcome.note: Voting concluded on 2026-08-02, but the result is announced in a separate email, not here. The replies show seven +1 votes marked binding, fourteen marked non-binding and one unmarked, with no +0 or -1.

why_it_matters: Once adopted, REST catalogs and clients have a specified way to exchange schemas that contain variant columns.
